name: gods-eye-view
description: A spy satellite simulator in your browser, except the data is real. Live open source spatial intelligence on a photorealistic 3D globe.
one_liner: A browser-based globe that shows real, live flights, ships, earthquakes, and traffic happening right now, which you can fly around with your voice like a spy-movie control room.
buyer: A news or explainer YouTuber who needs real-looking live footage of a breaking event (a wildfire, a diverted flight, a ship incident) without sending a camera crew.
business_use_cases: A news/explainer YouTuber uses it to film a live 'tracking shot' of a real wildfire, flight, or ship for a breaking-news video instead of licensing stock footage.
A logistics or marine-insurance company uses the live aircraft and ship tracking as a cheap, always-on situational-awareness dashboard for assets in transit.
An event-planning or emergency-management team uses the live earthquake and traffic layers to brief stakeholders during a developing incident without separate paid data feeds.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a paid 'pro' tier with higher-resolution camera feeds, saved views, and export-ready clips for media teams.
License a white-labeled version to logistics or insurance companies as an embedded tracking widget.

steal_this: Build a small Chrome-extension or OBS plugin that lets streamers drop a live 'spy satellite' camera window into their breaking-news livestream in one click.
